prompt:
You are in a prepared Django invoices repo (deps installed, migrate already run once).

This job is the OpenCode harness task (marker module only).

Do ALL of these, in order. Keep changes minimal.

1) Create Python module `app/fleet_marker.py` with exactly:
   FLEET_MARKER = "fleet-ok"

2) Create Django unit test `tests/test_fleet_smoke.py` that:
   - uses django.test.SimpleTestCase
   - imports FLEET_MARKER from app.fleet_marker
   - has a test method that asserts FLEET_MARKER == "fleet-ok"

3) Run tools only via fleet-wsexec (see FLEET_TOOLS.md), in this order:
   a) fleet-wsexec django_check
   b) fleet-wsexec django_migrate
   c) fleet-wsexec django_test_fleet   (required — one fast test, must pass)
   d) fleet-wsexec django_test         (full suite — try once)

4) Final summary: report pass/fail/timeout for each tool and that both files exist.

Rules:
- You may ONLY create/edit files under `app/` and `tests/`. Do not touch invoices/models or other apps.
- Use ONLY fleet-wsexec <tool-name> for project commands (no free shell installs).
- Do NOT pip install.
- Do NOT skip django_test_fleet — it is one fast test and must succeed.
- django_test is the full suite: run once after fleet smoke; if it fails or times out, report and stop.
- If check/migrate/test_fleet fails, fix only your two files under app/ and tests/ and re-run that tool.

django_test_fleet.description: Run only the small fleet smoke unit test (required)

django_test.description: Full Django test suite (optional stretch; timeout/fail is OK to report)
